title: Copied NBT lists remain independent
description: Copying a list and replacing its first member leaves the original list unchanged.

steps.command: summon minecraft:marker 2 64 2 {Tags:["pp"],data:{values:[2,4]}}
scoreboard players set length pp_audit -9999
execute store result score length pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values
scoreboard players set index0 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index0 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values[0]
scoreboard players set index1 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index1 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values[1]
execute if score length pp_audit matches 2 if score index0 pp_audit matches 2 if score index1 pp_audit matches 4

data modify entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.copy set from entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values
data modify entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.copy[0] set value 9
scoreboard players set length pp_audit -9999
execute store result score length pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values
scoreboard players set index0 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index0 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values[0]
scoreboard players set index1 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index1 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values[1]
execute if score length pp_audit matches 2 if score index0 pp_audit matches 2 if score index1 pp_audit matches 4
scoreboard players set length pp_audit -9999
execute store result score length pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.copy
scoreboard players set index0 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index0 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.copy[0]
scoreboard players set index1 pp_audit -9999
execute store result score index1 pp_audit run data get entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.copy[1]
execute if score length pp_audit matches 2 if score index0 pp_audit matches 9 if score index1 pp_audit matches 4

notes: Requires execute store result and indexed data get; missing support is visible. Initial list and final length/every index are positively observed. No client or elapsed-tick claim.
